vc_sentences: NIE022: Example and the literal copies in Field Options, Example Analysis and Sample File corrected to the accented string 'V1.0: Documento Soporte de Pago de Nómina Electrónica', as the Field Explanation and the client's live document require.
NIE013: Field Explanation records that the client's current document copies the employee's home country into the generation country for 6 documents and must not be replicated; query added.
NIE213: Query to RA added on the EMI record position that repeats the employer's corporate name (OtrosNombres by XSD order).

NIE041: Field Explanation adds that the client's current document codes 6 of the 20 interns as 19 and 14 as 01 although all 20 carry ApoyoSost; the 15 Oct sentence 'the client holds no worker-type code' corrected in M53 to refer to the payroll and Master Data reports; query extended.

NIE044: Query to RA added - the client's current document reports code 21 (not 22) for all 15 holders of the 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', the type following the foreigners' card where a citizenship card is also held; the 15 Oct mapping (22, DIAN Res. 000013/2021 annex table 5.2.1) stays.

NIE045: Field Explanation adds the document-number source observed in the client's current document (Citizenship Card ID for the 246 type-13 documents; the foreigners' card for the 15 type-21 documents, 1 of them also holding a citizenship card with the same number; 3 masked differences most likely a masking artefact).
NIE047: Field Explanation adds that the client's current document leaves SegundoApellido empty for the 144 employees without a second surname (no placeholder); CO-GAP-07 query extended.
NIE050: Field Explanation records that the client's current document reports the home-address country for 6 employees (the practice this field excludes); query added.
NIE051 / NIE052: Field Explanation records that the client's current document reports the employer's 05 / 05001 as place of work for all 261 employees, whatever their work location; query added.
NIE053: Field Explanation records that the client's current document fills the employee's home address (= Master Data 'Address Line 1', 261 of 261) as place-of-work address; query added.

NIE056: Field Explanation records that the client's current document flags only 45 of the 88 WT 62140 employees as integral although all 88 earn at least 13 SMMLV and contribute on 70% (62 of 88 evidenced); the WT-based rule stays; query added.
NIE061: Field Explanation adds that the client's current document already carries TipoContrato 2 / 4, so a client source exists outside the Master Data report; query extended.

NIE062: Field Explanation adds that the client's current document takes Sueldo from G2N 'Salary Assigned' (239 of 261, one with a 0.50 rounding residue), with the interns at 0.00 and 2 integral employees at twice Salary Assigned; query extended.

NIE065: Query to RA added - the client's current document reports Metodo 47 for all employees; the 4 'Cash' employees are zero-net expatriates absent from the bank file, so the open point is the Metodo of a zero-net document; the 15 Oct mapping stays.
NIE067: Query to RA added - the client's current document transmits the code '02' as TipoCuenta.

NIE203: Query to RA added on the off-cycle payment that a single free-text client note leaves out of the monthly document; the rule (every payment of the month reported, Res. 000013 de 2021 art. 3) stays.
NIE002: Field Explanation adds that the client's current document uses 'Hire Date' for all 261 employees; the query on rehired / transferred employees stays.
NIE006: Field Explanation records that the client's current document computes TiempoLaborado in calendar days as an integer, which differs from the annex 360-day construction; query added.

NIE069 (re-opened 15 Oct 2026, evening): Field Explanation takes DiasTrabajados from the monthly G2N 'Days Worked' (= 30 - 'Days On Leave'), the value the client's current document reports for 261 of 261 employees; the '30 minus Leave Absence days' fallback is withdrawn (that report counts business days and includes compensated vacation and earlier months).
NIE070: Field Explanation adds that the client's current document confirms WT 62100 + 62140 (261 of 261), reports the interns at 0.00 and maps arrears 62101 / 62141 and WT 65820 to this element.
NIE071: Field Explanation names the client's statutory transport WT 62520 and records that the current document reports WT 62523 as AuxilioNS (evidence for the decision-4 query).
NIE072: Field Explanation adds the client's per-diem WTs (62805-62810, 62820, 62821), currently all reported as salary per diems; query on permanent vs accidental added.
NIE082: Query to RA added - no overtime element in the September documents and the single free-text line in the client's reconciliation sheet is not evidence (Not evidenced).
NIE116: Query to RA added - the client's WT table sends WT 62116 'Vacation Terminations' to OtroConcepto, not to VacacionesCompensadas.
NIE118: Query to RA added on WT 62831, which the client's WT table assigns to Primas together with 62211.
NIE119: Field Explanation adds that the client reports 62208-62210 (and 62150, 62118, 62228, 65838) as BonificacionS today.
NIE120: Field Explanation adds that the client's WT table also maps 62182 and the fund-payment WT 65805 to Cesantias Pago.
NIE121: Field Explanation clarifies that 12% is the configured annual rate and that the reported rate is pro-rated to the period (client document: 9.00 in September).
NIE122: Field Explanation names the client WTs 62117 and 62127.
NIE131 / NIE135: Field Explanation names the client payout WTs (79406 / 79407; 79405, 79414, 79418, 79419, 79420).
NIE139 / NIE140: Field Explanation lists the client's bonus WTs per element and the unmapped WT 62202 'Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up'.
NIE141 / NIE142: Field Explanation lists the client's allowance WTs per element; WT 62133 'Variable' queried.

NIE146 / NIE148: Field Explanation records how the client's current document reports OtroConcepto (65821 and 67090 with client labels, zero-amount stock-award lines, 1910 / 67010 / 62216 absent) and the UTF-8 requirement.
NIE154: Field Explanation adds that the client's current document reports WT 65818 as PagoAlimentacionNS (211 of 211) with the offset 21115 in OtraDeduccion.
NIE193: Field Explanation records that the client's current document reports only 65802 and 65809 as accrued PagoTercero and the other informative benefits as AuxilioNS; decision query added.
NIE194: Field Explanation adds the client's advance WTs 61101, 61150, 61200 (client WT table).

NIE157: Field Explanation records that the client's current document carries ApoyoSost for all 20 interns but codes 14 of them as worker type 01 / contract 2; the 15 Oct sentence 'not held today' corrected in M177; query added.
NIE159: Field Explanation records that the client's WT table assigns WT 62203 to BonifRetiro and that the current document emits 0.00 on the intern documents; query added.
NIE161: Field Explanation records the 0 / 0.00 values the client's current document emits for the 20 interns; query added.
NIE167-NIE170: Query to RA added - the client's current document reports the whole WT 2553 as DeduccionSP without rates or subsistence amount; the split rule stays.
NIE177: Query to RA extended with the client's current practice (WT 21330 reported for all 6 employees; WT table includes 25834).
NIE198: Field Explanation adds the further WTs the client reports as PensionVoluntaria (21210-21212, 21141, 25810, 25819-25822).
NIE179: Field Explanation names the client AFC WTs.

NIE171 / NIE172: Field Explanation records that the client's current document emits one Sindicato per employee with a 1.50% rate and the summed union WTs, contrary to the per-WT repetition proposed; the 15 Oct sentence 'The rate is not in the payroll output' corrected in M195; decision query added.
NIE176: Field Explanation names the client libranza WTs 21119-21121.
NIE195: Field Explanation lists what the client's current document reports as PagoTercero (deduction), including the Foncoltabaco employee-fund deductions.
NIE196: Field Explanation records that the client's current document reports all WT 21215 lines as Anticipo and leaves them out of ComprobanteTotal.
NIE197: Field Explanation lists what the client's current document reports as OtraDeduccion.
NIE180: Field Explanation records that the client reports Foncoltabaco as PagoTercero / OtraDeduccion and only 21616-21618 as Cooperativa; decision query added.
NIE181: Field Explanation names the client garnishment WTs 21125, 21190, 21200.

NIE182: Field Explanation adds the rule that prepaid medicine, a complementary health plan or a health insurance policy are reported in PlanComplementarios and other insurance products in OtrasDeducciones; query added on the product behind WTs 21610-21612 (reported as OtraDeduccion today).

NIE187-NIE189: Field Explanations record how the client's current document computes the totals (G2N Gross / Total Deductions / Net, net + WT 21215) and that this does not equal the sums of the elements; the TOT position order is confirmed as the XSD v1.0.6 order (DevengadosTotal, DeduccionesTotal, ComprobanteTotal) and the client label 'TOT_03' noted as inconsistent with its 1-based table; the 15 Oct parenthetical on WT 26998 corrected in M214 (equal to the net for 224 of 259); queries added.
